categories.main_business_segments: Taihan Cable & Solution Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the cable manufacturing sector, focusing on power cables including ultra-high voltage cables, communication cables, and related materials. The company also provides comprehensive electrical, communication, and fire protection construction services, positioning itself as a total solution provider in the cable industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in ultra-high voltage cable production, including HVDC cables and submarine cables, supported by continuous R&D efforts. It employs manufacturing facilities domestically in Korea and overseas in Vietnam, South Africa, and Saudi Arabia, with production methods emphasizing high-quality materials like copper and aluminum and specialized processes for durable, high-performance cables including nano-technology for insulation and international certification standards compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Taihan serves a diverse customer base including public institutions such as Korea Electric Power Corporation, private sector companies, and international clients in the US, Europe, Middle East, and emerging markets. Its products are critical for power transmission, distribution, and communication infrastructure, targeting utility companies, construction firms, and telecommunication operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales presence in Korea, Vietnam, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the US, Europe, and the Middle East. It has expanded its footprint through overseas subsidiaries and joint ventures, actively pursuing projects in North America, Europe, and emerging markets to diversify and grow its international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: Taihan operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing cables and related components from raw materials like copper and aluminum. It also engages downstream by providing installation and construction services, offering end-to-end solutions from production to project execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-value-added products such as ultra-high voltage and submarine cables, including HVDC technology, with recent achievements in international certifications. Strategic initiatives include expanding into the offshore wind power sector with submarine cable laying vessels and new production plants, enhancing ESG management, and developing carbon-neutral roadmaps aligned with global sustainability trends.
categories.revenue_model: Taihan generates revenue primarily through product sales of power and communication cables, supplemented by construction and installation service contracts. It also earns income from overseas subsidiaries and joint ventures, with export sales constituting a significant portion of total revenue. The company conducts capital raising through equity issuance to fund expansion projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic players like LS Cable & System and Gaon Cable, and internationally with firms such as Prysmian, Nexans, and NKT in the submarine cable market. Taihan is recognized for its high-quality ultra-high voltage cable technology and is expanding its presence in the offshore wind and submarine cable sectors, positioning itself as a leading Korean cable manufacturer with growing global competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Taihan reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 2.84 trillion in 2023, marking a 16.1% increase from the previous year, with operating profit and net income also showing significant growth. The company has a robust asset base exceeding KRW 1.87 trillion and has undertaken substantial capital investments, including a recent KRW 462.5 billion equity raise to finance new production facilities and overseas expansions, reflecting a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taihan emphasizes superior product quality, especially in ultra-high voltage and submarine cables, backed by advanced R&D and international certifications. Its value proposition includes comprehensive total solutions from manufacturing to installation, strong global project execution capabilities, and strategic investments in emerging sectors like offshore wind power, differentiating it through technological leadership and global market expansion.
